div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://hemonc.org/fhir/CodeSystem/sig-target-type defines the following codes:

tr.td: Target dose expressed in mg/m² (multiply by BSA at $apply)
The doseQuantity is the literal per-m² target from the protocol. Computed mg = doseQuantity.value × BSA(patient, formula, cap).
The doseQuantity is the target AUC. Computed mg = AUC × (effectiveGFR + 25), where effectiveGFR is min(GFR(patient, formula), GFR-cap).
Target dose expressed in mg/kg (multiply by weight)
The doseQuantity is the literal per-kg target. Computed mg = doseQuantity.value × WeightKg(patient).
Literal absolute mg dose (no patient-specific computation needed)
The doseQuantity is the dispensed mg as-is. CQL helpers are not invoked.
Computed mg dose derived from a target-AUC (provenance marker)
Set on MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.doseAndRate.type after $apply, so the original target paradigm is recoverable from the order.
Computed mg dose derived from a per-m² target (provenance marker)
